additional_info.subject: RE: ID0413011-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P8 170004167] OCPP offline CRM:00579001592
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
Greetings of the day!
We have checked Router settings and found that-
It shows SIM card not inserted
We suspect that- either SIM is not working or SIM port in Router is not working. Hence, need to check the both.
We recommend you to visit the site with working SIM and spare router. And your laptop should have working Companion tool to configure router if required.
First you need to take out and check if SIM is working, and then you need to insert it properly (Not upside down).
Also check if it has active data plan.
If its not working, then check with the new SIM.
Even if it does not work, need to replace router.
Do let us know if you have any queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
